notes.title: Update Notice: Bug Fixes and Application of the Latest Version
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

First of all, I sincerely apologize for releasing the game with some issues still present. I appreciate your understanding and patience as I worked to resolve these problems.

After the release, a few bugs were discovered, and I have promptly addressed and fixed them.

This update includes the following bug fixes:

[list] [b]Mouse Pointer Hide Setting[/b]: Fixed an issue where the mouse pointer would not hide properly.
[b]Resolution Adjustment[/b]: The game's resolution has been changed to a 16:9 aspect ratio for a more stable display.
[b]Language Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where the language would not change correctly in certain situations.
[b]Option Click Bug[/b]: Resolved an issue where clicking on specific options in the menu caused problems.
[/list]
I also apologize for the previous release containing some of these bugs. Although these issues were fixed before release, the method for applying the latest version was not properly followed, resulting in the deployment of an earlier version. The game has now been updated to the final version with all issues resolved.

I am committed to providing you with the best gaming experience possible. Please feel free to provide feedback or report any bugs, and I will respond quickly.

Thank you.
